title: Hate-CLIPper: Multimodal Hateful Meme Classification based on Cross-modal Interaction of CLIP Features
benchmark_measurement: Detection of hateful memes targeting protected categories, which explicitly includes religion.
findings: The proposed model, Hate-CLIPper, using its feature interaction matrix (FIM), was able to identify and cluster hateful memes based on their underlying concepts. The interpretability analysis showed that the model successfully grouped memes targeting religion into specific clusters (e.g., Cluster 13), demonstrating its ability to learn and recognize religion-based hateful content.
